verdict.rationale: Full-text search is a fair question for a database product, so the axis applies. The pack documents chained filters and sorting, KNN vector search, and a MongoDB-compatible API. None of these is documented native full-text search, and vector similarity search is a different capability. A community comment also describes Firebase as having an 'unintuitive lack of server-side query options.'

support.subject: As a developer, I can run full-text search over my data without wiring up an external search service
